question.prompt: What observable dashboard change should prove that switching away from Comfortable has updated display density?

options.label: Need source
options.detail: Add or cite source text that defines the visible density change to expect after selecting Compact or Spacious.

options.label: Spacing only
options.detail: Treat density as changing component spacing only, without asserting typography or control sizing.

options.label: Spacing and text
options.detail: Treat density as changing spacing plus text sizing throughout the dashboard.

content.risk_rationale: Density control is part of the use-case and the final acceptance checklist, but the corpus only names the density options and says the control works; it never defines the visible delta that proves Compact or Spacious changed the dashboard.
